description: Bump the prettier devDependency to ^3 and add the Prettier 3 explicit plugin-free defaults marker comment to .prettierrc when present.
name: prettier-3-upgrade
notes: Dependency range only — Prettier 3 changed some defaults (e.g. trailingComma) and formatting output will differ on the next format run; this recipe does not reformat your sources. Nested package.json files still on ^2 are reported as unhandled.
